# Always-on smoke suite for the fast tier (`make test`).
# Format: name;fen;expected;note
#
# Seeded from tests/fixtures/positions.txt (converted from the CLI corpus
# format `fen;expected;max_pv_plies`; the smoke suite makes no PV-length
# assertions) and from representative entries of
# tests/fixtures/decisive_positions.txt chosen to exercise different mate
# themes. The assertion property is "no wrong decisive result": a decisive
# outcome must match `expected`, and a `Draw` is accepted only when the search
# was cut short by the 2-second timeout (or when `Draw` is the expected
# outcome, which covers terminal stalemate draws). See tests/test_smoke.rs.
#
# Entries whose note carries a child-evals budget (`unproven_evals:<B>` /
# `solvable_evals:<B>`) are routed to the deterministic helpers instead of the
# wall-clock assertion. The m22 entry is the deep-search tripwire: it uses a
# deterministic child-evals budget instead of the 2 s wall-clock timeout, so
# it stays cheap and machine-independent while still exercising the
# deep-search machinery in the fast tier (plan3 task 3.3).
